prompt.project_info: A quiet morning bedroom portrait with side-window chiaroscuro and ivory linen texture.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with a feminine silhouette, long natural blonde waves, subtle peach-rose makeup, and visible natural skin texture, seated on a bed and holding a large ivory duvet. She wears the source-inspired warm beige satin camisole with a flattering neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical waist-up close portrait; bed and ivory duvet fill the lower frame, a dark neutral room recedes behind her, and all text, logos, and watermarks are absent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong side-window morning light at 4700K creates defined highlights, soft shadows enhancing the feminine silhouette, and sunlight highlighting shoulders and chest area. Preserve pores, flyaway hairs, linen wrinkles, muted gold/ivory palette, and natural grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens at f/1.8, vertical 3:4 crop, shallow depth of field, filmic highlight roll-off, realistic perspective, subtle 35mm grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic close portrait of an adult woman with a feminine silhouette sitting on a bed and holding a large fluffy ivory duvet, long naturally wavy blonde hair, subtle peach-rose makeup, visible natural skin texture, and a warm beige satin camisole with a flattering neckline. Strong natural morning sunlight from a side window creates pronounced chiaroscuro, sunlight highlighting shoulders and chest area, and realistic shadows enhancing curves; ivory bedding, dark neutral room, realistic linen wrinkles, shallow depth of field, 35mm f/1.8, vertical framing, no text, logos, or watermarks.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, lingerie, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed hands
